articles.title: UBS Forecasts Gold at $5,200 by Mid-2027, Calls Current Dip a Buying Opportunity
articles.excerpt: The Swiss bank sees roughly 30% upside from current levels as the Fed holds rates, the dollar weakens, and central banks keep buying at record pace.
articles.nri_angle: Gold remains the most popular investment among the Indian diaspora, and UBS's bullish forecast adds to the case for accumulating during the current correction.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: JPMorgan Chase Pledges $750 Billion for U.S. Housing Through 2035
articles.excerpt: The nation's largest bank plans to finance one million affordable units and help half a million buyers purchase homes under its American Dream Initiative.
articles.nri_angle: Indian-American homebuyers in high-cost metros like San Francisco and New York stand to benefit from expanded mortgage lending and affordable housing financing.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: India Extends Contract Manufacturing Tax Breaks to 2041, Handing Apple a Major Expansion Win
articles.excerpt: A proposed amendment would give foreign electronics firms a 15-year tax exemption on machinery and components supplied to Indian contract manufacturers, up from the five-year window set in February.
articles.nri_angle: India’s growing role in global iPhone production creates jobs and supply-chain opportunities that Indian professionals track closely.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: India to Sell Up to 6.5% LIC Stake via Offer for Sale Starting August 4
articles.excerpt: The government set a floor price of ₹382 per share for the OFS, a 10.8% discount to LIC’s closing price, as it works to meet SEBI’s 10% public-float deadline by May 2027.
articles.nri_angle: NRIs with LIC policies or Indian market investments will want to track the pricing and potential impact on the stock.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: India Rolls Out Sweeping Tax and Digital Payments Overhaul Across 2026
articles.excerpt: The new Income Tax Act, GST 2.0, and RBI stricter authentication rules are collectively reshaping how India taxes, transacts, and regulates its booming digital economy.
articles.nri_angle: NRI property transaction reforms, foreign asset disclosure window, and expanded digital access powers during tax investigations affect diaspora financial planning
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Global AI Trade Unwind Drives Foreign Investors Back to Indian Equities
articles.excerpt: After selling $29 billion in the first half of 2026, foreign investors turned net buyers of Indian stocks in July as a pullback in AI-linked markets triggered a major rotation into India's diversified benchmarks.
articles.nri_angle: NRI investors with portfolios spanning U.S. tech and Indian equities face rebalancing decisions as the AI-to-India rotation reshapes global flows.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Juniper Green Energy IPO Closes 8x Oversubscribed as Institutions Drive Final-Day Surge
articles.excerpt: The ₹1,800 crore renewable energy IPO saw QIB demand reach 26x on its last day, though retail investors stayed cautious at just 0.68x subscription.
articles.nri_angle: India's renewable energy sector draws global capital including Abu Dhabi Investment Authority; NRI investors tracking India's clean energy transition will note the strong institutional backing despite muted retail participation.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Fed's Williams Expects Inflation to Ease but Warns Rate Hikes Remain on the Table
articles.excerpt: The New York Fed president said disinflationary forces should reassert themselves, but the central bank stands ready to raise borrowing costs if price pressures persist above the 2% target.
articles.nri_angle: Persistent US inflation and potential rate hikes affect Indian-American purchasing power, dollar-rupee remittance values, and the large diaspora workforce in AI and tech sectors.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: RBI Expected to Hold Repo Rate at 5.25% as Global Peers Pivot to Hikes
articles.excerpt: Nearly 95% of economists in a Reuters poll predict the central bank will keep rates unchanged when the MPC announces its decision on Wednesday, choosing to look through rising inflation rather than follow peers into tightening.
articles.nri_angle: The RBI's capital-inflow measures and NRI deposit scheme enhancements directly affect diaspora investors, while a potential future rate hike cycle could reshape fixed-income and equity allocations for those with Indian exposure.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: SEBI Bars Zee's Subhash Chandra and Punit Goenka From Securities Market for One Year
articles.excerpt: India's market regulator imposed ₹1.48 crore in penalties on Zee Entertainment, its CEO, and founder-chairman emeritus after finding company land was secretly pledged for promoter-linked loans.
articles.image_caption: Subhash Chandra, founder of Zee Entertainment, has been barred from the securities market by SEBI for one year.
articles.nri_angle: Zee channels are widely watched by the Indian diaspora, and the governance issues may concern NRI investors holding ZEEL shares or mutual funds with exposure to the stock.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Bharti Airtel, Trent, SBI Among 215 Stocks to Report Q1 Results This Week
articles.excerpt: India's busiest earnings week of the season features heavyweights across telecom, real estate, retail, and banking, with multiple sectors expected to show profit declines.
articles.nri_angle: NRI investors with exposure to Indian equities face a pivotal week as major holdings across telecom, banking, and consumer sectors report numbers that will shape portfolio decisions.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Trump's Pharma Tariff Countdown Begins, Indian Generic Drugmakers Face Uncertain Future
articles.excerpt: With a two-year grace period now ticking and 100% tariffs on generic drugs set for 2028, India's $8.7 billion pharmaceutical export pipeline to the US faces its biggest test yet.
articles.nri_angle: Indian pharmaceutical companies that employ thousands of diaspora professionals face major revenue risk, while generic drug tariffs could raise medication costs for Indian-Americans who rely on affordable generics.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Persistent Systems Reports Rs 483 Crore Q1 Profit as Nagarro Deal Dominates Outlook
articles.excerpt: The mid-tier IT firm's net profit rose 13.7% year-on-year but fell 9% sequentially, as the spotlight shifts to its transformative $2.9 billion Nagarro acquisition.
articles.image_caption: Persistent Systems reported quarterly profit of Rs 483 crore, with its Nagarro acquisition shaping the company's outlook.
articles.nri_angle: Persistent Systems, a major employer of Indian tech talent, is making India's largest cross-border IT acquisition, reshaping the global IT services pecking order.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: AstraZeneca and Bristol Myers Squibb in Talks on $400 Billion Pharma Megadeal
articles.excerpt: The potential tie-up would create one of the world's largest pharmaceutical companies, combining AstraZeneca's oncology dominance with Bristol Myers' immunology portfolio.
articles.nri_angle: A deal of this magnitude would reshape the global pharmaceutical landscape, with implications for drug pricing and availability across markets including India
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: S&P 500 Earnings Beats Hit Five-Year Highs as Consumers Absorb Surging Costs
articles.excerpt: Corporate America is posting its strongest profit season since 2021, driven by AI spending and soaring energy margins, even as gasoline prices above $4 a gallon and rising inflation squeeze household budgets.
articles.nri_angle: Indian-American investors benefit from an earnings-driven stock rally while Indian IT firms stand to gain from the AI infrastructure spending powering tech profits, though rising energy and living costs weigh on household budgets.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk
